items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: You know at one point Billy Butterfield was getting his 802 card, so was Conrad Gozzo and I. And Billy came in and played third trumpet while he was getting his 802 card.

ctx.x: Right. Thank you. And they were great players working for — You know at one point Billy Butterfield was getting his 802 card, so was Conrad Gozzo and I. And Billy came in and played third trumpet while he was getting his 802 card. And in doing an interview on WKCR they looked at the personnel on different record dates, and he said, “Are you sure that was the trumpet section?” It was.
Yeah the union was very strong wasn’t it.
